tests_added_or_strengthened: A dynamic 1,000-line production-module ceiling with executable 1,000/1,001-line boundary helpers.
Deferred-promise eager-start and deterministic ten-iteration manual-finalization latency tests.

Bundled-frontend versus public-backend compatibility contracts for the removed RPC aliases.
All seven typed settings-patch variants, invalid-patch rejection, persistence reload, and cross-service-instance merge coverage.

task_1_broad_module_ceiling.result: Replaced 26 manually maintained size budgets with dynamic production discovery and one named 1,000-line last-resort ceiling; runtime code was unchanged.

task_2_concurrent_manual_finalization.result: The refresh result, operation status, recent logs, and game history reads now start together through one typed Promise.all while publication order, history status handling, selected-game preference, and mounted guards remain unchanged.

task_3_canonical_logging_transport.result: Updater and installer logging use the canonical utility; direct Decky log-callable ownership falls from three production modules to one.

task_4_bounded_hidden_qam_capture.result: A hidden QAM captures immediately and then nine more times at 500 ms intervals, cancels on cleanup, and stops permanently after 4.5 seconds; opening QAM still performs an authoritative synchronous capture first.

task_5_canonical_notification_policy.result: The state snapshot no longer mirrors notification values beside settings; selectors retain cold-state defaults and derive policy from normalized settings.

task_6_remove_unused_compatibility_rpcs.result: Removed the unused handle_game_start, handle_game_exit, and clear_ludusavi_launcher_shortcut_id public aliases and wrappers. Supported check-then-operation flows and the -1 shortcut sentinel remain covered.

task_7_typed_atomic_settings_patch.result: Seven frontend setting RPCs became update_settings; one keyed optimistic runtime applies only owned fields, while the backend validates patches and uses locked Persistence.mutate_settings read-modify-write against the latest settings document. The review cleanup removed unused updater/service persistence routes, restored the empty game-name guard, and kept mutation sequence numbers monotonic across dispose.

task_8_debug_logging_observational.result: Released watches stop and join from the sole registry at both INFO and DEBUG. The accepted tradeoff is recorded: delete-pruning is not observed after frontend release. stop_all snapshots all watches before clearing and now has explicit two-watch coverage.

task_9_typescript_boundaries.result: Removed every production any from the eleven evaluated RPC, updater, QAM, modal, installer, and monitor boundaries; RpcStatus checks now narrow unions through real type predicates and runtime behavior is unchanged.
task_9_typescript_boundaries.commit_body_exception: The committed body contains literal \n\n characters where paragraph breaks were intended. It was intentionally not amended or rebased because the review note is already a durable record on top of it. This session record preserves the defect and its intended two-paragraph separation; all subsequent commit bodies in this round use real paragraph breaks.

task_10_reconciliation.result: Reconciled actual dev-to-HEAD metrics, inspected README.md and DEVELOPMENT.md without changing them, confirmed the three rejected prototypes remain absent, ran required negative controls, and recorded the complete evidence here.
